name: CJC-1295

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A modified growth hormone-releasing factor analogue, circulated with and without a drug-affinity complex (DAC) that extends half-life by albumin binding. It has no FDA-approved product, no approved labelling, and is sold for laboratory research use. No FDA label exists. Not equivalent to an approved growth-hormone product.

systems.note: GHRH receptor agonism at the somatotroph; placed on the pituitary by intended effect.
Sought for downstream anabolic and body-composition effect.
Sustained GH elevation antagonises insulin action.

monitors.why: The only practical index of achieved GH exposure; no approved dosing reference exists.
